decisions.decision: List files with git ls-files (--cached --others --exclude-standard), count ignored with --others --ignored
decisions.why: git applies root, nested, info/exclude and global ignore rules exactly
decisions.rejected: pathspec gitignore matcher (new dependency, imperfect nested semantics)

decisions.decision: Run git with core.fsmonitor=false, hooksPath disabled, --no-optional-locks, no shell
decisions.why: keeps ingestion read-only and stops repo config from running programs (constitution VII, FR-017)

decisions.decision: Skip order vendored, symlink(ignored), too large, binary (NUL or invalid UTF-8); limits via CCCTX_MAX_FILE_BYTES and CCCTX_VENDOR_DIRS
decisions.why: cheap path checks first; file read only when needed

decisions.decision: chunker returns None on no grammar or root has_error; caller windows 60 lines every 50
decisions.why: spec chose whole-file fallback on any syntax error; keeps chunker pure
decisions.rejected: partial results from trees with ERROR nodes

decisions.decision: Chunk ranges are whole lines and source is exactly those lines
decisions.why: stored source matches what an editor shows for the range

decisions.decision: Fallback chunks use kind chunk, named <file>:<start>-<end>
decisions.why: schema already allows chunk; no new column

decisions.decision: One transaction per ingest: lock repo row nowait, delete files (cascade), insert files returning id, executemany symbols with CLOB source, commit
decisions.why: FR-011/FR-012 via Oracle transaction; ORA-00054 reports concurrent ingest

implement.summary: ccctx ingest/symbols/stats: read-only git walk with skip rules, tree-sitter chunks for Python/Go/JavaScript, 60/10 window fallback, commit_sha per symbol, one-transaction replace

approach: ingest.py lists files via read-only git, applies vendored/symlink/size/binary skips, and chunks each file with chunker.py (tree-sitter Python/Go/JavaScript by definition, else 60-line windows every 50). It replaces the repo's files and symbols in one transaction with commit_sha from HEAD (migration 2) and returns a summary the CLI prints and logs; ccctx symbols and stats read it back.
